name: InputField
purpose: Single-line text entry with label, hint, and error wiring built in. Supports text, email, number, password (with show/hide), tel, url.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Placeholders are not labels.

props.name: hint
props.description: Format guidance shown above the input ('e.g. 12:30').

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; sets aria-invalid. Say how to fix it.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type. password adds a show/hide button; on native sets keyboardType/secureTextEntry.

props.name: showOptional
props.description: Show '(optional)' instead — use when most fields are required.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Always set for personal data (email, name, tel) — WCAG 1.3.5.

states.name: invalid
states.description: 2px border.danger, error message with icon below.

tokens.usage: Input text — 16px minimum prevents iOS zoom.

screenReader: Announces label, required state, value, then hint and error via aria-describedby.
Password toggle is a separate button announced as 'Show password, toggle button'.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the whole control (focus-within).
notes: Validate on blur or submit, not on every keystroke.
On submit with errors, move focus to the first invalid field or an error summary.

do: Use the right type and autoComplete so mobile shows the right keyboard and autofill.
Size the field to the expected input length.
dont: Don't use placeholder text as the label.
Don't show errors before the user has had a chance to type.
Don't disable paste in password fields.

related.name: Search
related.reason: Search-specific input with clear button and landmark.

example.web:
<InputField label="Team name" required hint="3–24 characters" error={errors.team} />
<InputField label="Email" type="email" autoComplete="email" iconStart="user" />
<InputField label="Entry fee" type="number" suffix="USD" showOptional />
example.native:
<InputField label="Team name" value={name} onChangeText={setName} error={errors.team} />
<InputField label="Password" type="password" autoComplete="password" />
